limited.body: This account is not active right now, so only some sections are available. Staff boards can still finish open orders but cannot create new tickets.
limited.reachable: You can still use Billing, Team, Settings (data export and deletion) and Account.
limited.notAllowed: You do not have access to this section.

banners.pastDue: Your paid period has ended. Renew to avoid suspension.
banners.pastDueUntil: Your paid period has ended. Renew before {{date}} to avoid suspension.
banners.suspended: This account is suspended. Staff can finish open orders but cannot create new tickets. Contact us to renew or resolve this.
banners.trialExpired: Your free trial has ended. Contact us to choose a plan and keep issuing tickets.
banners.cancelled: Your subscription is cancelled. Contact us to renew and keep issuing tickets.
banners.deletionRequested: Account deletion was requested on {{date}}. It will be deleted 7 days after the request.
banners.verifyEmail: Please verify your email address ({{email}}). Check your inbox for the link.
banners.supportActive: Platform support ({{name}}) is viewing this account.

signIn.mfaPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

signIn.enrollElsewhere: Two-factor setup is required for this account.

handoff.title: Signing you in

handoff.signInInstead: Sign in with email and password

invitation.existingUser: You already have an account. Enter your password to accept.
invitation.name: Your name

steps.branding: Add your logo or brand colour
steps.staff_device: Sign in on a staff tablet

today.title: Today
today.longestNote: Waiting time counts from when the ticket was created.

reports.title: Reports
reports.empty: No data for this range yet. Reports update hourly.
reports.chartLabel: Stacked bar chart of alert reach per day: push sent, page open, page closed and no alerts. The same numbers are in the table below.
reports.prepNote: Preparation time is measured from ticket creation.
reports.wordingNote: We report what the system did (push sent, page open, acknowledged) — we cannot know whether a customer noticed the alert.
reports.dailyNoCounter: The per-day view always covers all counters.
reports.csvHint: One row per ticket for the dates above (Pro plan).

general.name: Venue name
general.timeZoneUnknown: Unknown time zone. Pick one from the list.
general.languageUnavailable: This language is not available on your plan.
general.nextDayNote: Changes to the time zone, reset time and auto-close time apply from the next business day, so today's numbering is not disturbed.
general.pending: Scheduled from {{date}}: reset at {{reset}}, auto-close at {{close}}.
general.pendingZone: From {{date}} the time zone changes from {{current}} to {{zone}}.
general.addressTooLong: Each address line can have up to 200 characters.

branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. A square logo works best.

logoProblem.type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
logoProblem.size: The image is larger than 2 MB.

branding.contrastNote: Text on your colour switches to black or white automatically so it stays readable.

preview.title: Customer page preview
preview.caption: Live preview of the customer's phone. Changes show before you save.
preview.readyText: Your order is ready. Please collect it from the counter.
preview.welcomeDefault: We will alert you here when your order is ready.

messages.intro: Short texts shown on the customer page. Leave a field empty to use the default wording.
messages.tooLong: Keep it to {{max}} characters or fewer.
messages.websiteHint: Must start with https://. Shown as a plain domain.
messages.urlInvalid: Enter a full link starting with https://

flow.showReceived: Show a Received column on the staff board
flow.waitHint: Customers see an estimated wait. Staff can adjust it per ticket.
flow.skipHint: Separate with commas; ranges like 13-19 are allowed.
flow.alertsHint: When a ticket is Ready the customer is alerted at once, then repeated at these times until acknowledged.
flow.checkCodeLegend: Ask for the 4-digit check code at collection
flow.checkCodeHint: The code is shown on the customer's phone and stops the wrong person collecting.

errors.rangeEnd: Enter a number from 1 to 9999, greater than the first number.
errors.skipNumbers: Use numbers from 1 to 9999 separated by commas (ranges like 13-19).
errors.repeatOffsets: Use up to 5 ascending values from 30 to 1800 seconds.
errors.reviewLinkUrl: Enter a full link starting with https://
errors.chime: Choose a sound from the list.

waitModes.off: Do not show a wait estimate

flow.waitAutoNote: Uses the typical preparation time of the last orders at this venue. Until there are enough orders, the default minutes below are used.
flow.prefixesEnabled: Show counter prefixes in ticket numbers
flow.prefixesHint: For example A12 for the Drinks counter. Set prefixes on the Counters page.
flow.claimsHint: How a customer who opens the venue page can link to their order.

claimsModes.off: Off (only the receipt link or QR)
claimsModes.staff_approval: Number, then staff approve on the board

flow.reviewLinkHint: Shown after collection, for example your Google Maps review page. Must start with https://
flow.showPoweredByHint: Hiding it is available on the Pro plan.
flow.soundOnApiTicket: Play a sound when a POS or integration creates a ticket
flow.soundOnApiTicketHint: Helps staff notice orders they did not type in.
flow.chimeHint: Played on customers' phones and the display when an order is ready.

staff.supportNoCredentials: During support access you can see and sign out staff devices. The staff link and PIN stay with the restaurant team.
staff.linkHint: Open this link on the staff tablet or PC, then enter the PIN. Do not share it outside your team.
staff.qrLabel: QR code of the staff board link
staff.rotateBody: The old link stops working and every staff device is signed out. You will need to open the new link on each device.
staff.rotated: Staff link reset. All devices were signed out.
staff.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits. Sequences like 1234 and repeated digits are not allowed.
staff.pinWeak: Choose a PIN that is not a sequence or a repeated digit.
staff.pinSignsOut: Changing the PIN signs out every staff device.
staff.pinChanged: PIN changed. All devices were signed out.
staff.devicesHint: Devices stay signed in for 30 days of use.
staff.removeBody: The device must enter the link and PIN again to use the board.

displays.addHint: Create a display, then open /display on the TV and enter the pairing code.
displays.name: Display name
displays.soundOffHelp: Sound is off on this display. Tap the screen on the TV once to allow sound so number announcements play.
displays.pairingIntro: On the TV, open the display page and enter this code:
displays.unpairBody: The TV is disconnected and the display is removed. You can add it again later.
displays.noCounters: This venue has no counters yet.
displays.languagesHint: Choose up to {{max}} languages; numbers are announced in this order.
displays.quietHoursHint: No announcements during these times (up to 3 periods, can pass midnight).
displays.promoHint: A short message shown beside the order lists. It never covers the Ready numbers.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.counterIds: Choose at least one counter, or show all counters.
errors.quietHours: Each period needs a start and an end time, and they must differ.
errors.promoText: Keep each text to 280 characters or fewer.
errors.promoImageUrl: Enter a full link starting with https://

posters.pdfHint: Place them where customers wait. The QR opens your venue page.
posters.printHint: An Arabic poster you can print directly from this browser.
posters.qrLabel: QR code of the venue page

sheet.headline: Scan to follow your order
sheet.step1: Scan the code with your phone camera
sheet.step2: Enter your order number or follow the link on your receipt
sheet.step3: We will alert you as soon as your order is ready

team.inviteHint: Managers can run the venue, staff access and reports. Billing and deletion stay with the owner.
team.name: Name
team.transferBody: There is one owner at a time. You will become a manager and lose access to billing and deletion. Enter your password to confirm.
team.removeBody: They lose access to this restaurant immediately.

billing.renewBody: Payments are made directly to our team by cash, bank transfer or wallet. Contact us to choose a plan, renew or change plans; your account is updated as soon as the payment is recorded.
billing.noPrices: Prices are not published yet. Please contact us.
billing.viewOnly: Billing is view only in a support session.

excess.maxVenues: Venues: you have {{current}}, the plan allows {{allowed}}. Archive {{n}} venue(s).
excess.maxCountersPerVenue: Counters in a venue: {{current}}, the plan allows {{allowed}}. Remove {{n}} counter(s).
excess.maxLanguages: Customer languages in a venue: {{current}}, the plan allows {{allowed}}. Remove {{n}} language(s).
excess.maxDisplaysPerVenue: Displays in a venue: {{current}}, the plan allows {{allowed}}. Remove {{n}} display(s).
excess.maxStaffDevicesPerVenue: Staff devices in a venue: {{current}}, the plan allows {{allowed}}. Sign out {{n}} device(s).
excess.maxApiKeysPerVenue: API keys in a venue: {{current}}, the plan allows {{allowed}}. Revoke {{n}} key(s).
excess.other: A limit of the plan is exceeded ({{current}} of {{allowed}}). Remove {{n}} item(s).

settings.billingEmailHint: Invoices go here. Leave empty to use the owner's email.
settings.exportHint: Download a ZIP with your tickets, settings and team as CSV files.
settings.exportFailed: The export failed. Please try again.
settings.deletionHint: All data is deleted 7 days after the request. You can cancel within those 7 days. Export your data first if you need it.
settings.deletionPending: Deletion is scheduled for {{date}}. You can cancel until then.
settings.slugExplain: If you change it, the old address keeps redirecting to the new one for 180 days. Printed QR codes and ticket links keep working because they do not use this address.
settings.slugHint: 3 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
settings.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens (not at the start or end).

account.name: Name
account.emailHint: Contact support to change your email address.
account.passwordRejected: Choose a different password (it may be too common).
account.passwordSignsOut: Your other sessions will be signed out.
account.mfaIntro: Use an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) to add a 6-digit code at sign-in.
account.mfaScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
account.mfaQr: QR code for your authenticator app
account.mfaRemoveBody: Your account will be protected by your password only.
account.mfaPasswordHint: Confirms it is you. Leave empty if you sign in with Google only (then sign in again first if it was more than 15 minutes ago).
account.mfaRemoveCode: Enter a code from your authenticator app to turn two-factor off.
account.mfaSignInAgain: For your security, sign out and sign in again, then set up two-factor within 15 minutes.
account.mfaRequiredByVenues: Two-factor sign-in is required while you manage several venues, so it cannot be turned off.
account.deleteHint: Your user account and sign-in are deleted. Restaurants you are a member of are not deleted. Your name is removed from the activity log.
account.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out.
account.deleteOnlyOwner: You are the only owner of a restaurant. Transfer ownership on the Team page (or delete the restaurant) first.
account.emailPending: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Your email changes when you open it (valid for 24 hours).
account.emailChangeHint: We send a link to the new address and tell the current address about the change. Other devices are signed out once it is confirmed.
account.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
account.weeklySummaryHint: A short summary of last week for this restaurant, every Sunday morning.

upsell.feature: This feature is not included in your current plan. It is available on the Pro plan.
upsell.limit: You have reached the limit of your current plan. Upgrade to add more.
upsell.askOwner: Ask the restaurant owner to upgrade.

mfaRequired.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
mfaRequired.body: This restaurant has more than one venue, so owners and managers must use an authenticator app when signing in. Set it up now to continue.
mfaRequired.signInAgain: Two-factor is already set up for your account. Sign out and sign in again with your 6-digit code.
mfaRequired.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to continue.

legal.title: Updated terms
legal.body: We have updated the documents below. Please read them and accept to keep using the service.
legal.checkFailed: We could not check whether there are new documents to accept. Try again to continue.
legal.changed: These documents were updated while you were reading. Please review the current versions.
legal.openVersion: Open this version in a new tab
legal.consent: I have read and accept the {{documents}} shown above.

venues.addHint: Each venue has its own staff board, displays, QR posters and numbering. Plans are priced per venue.
venues.name: Venue name
venues.archiveBody: Its staff devices, displays and API keys stop working. Ticket history stays in your reports. Venues with open tickets cannot be archived.
venues.archiveOpenTickets: This venue still has open tickets. Close or collect them on the staff board, then try again.
venues.billingNote: The price is per venue: adding or archiving a venue changes what you pay from your next renewal.

counters.addHint: Counters split orders by pickup point, for example Drinks and Food. The optional prefix appears before the number (A12, D1-7).
counters.name: Counter name
counters.prefixHint: 1 to 3 characters: a capital letter, then letters or digits (A, D1).
counters.prefixInvalid: Use 1 to 3 characters starting with a capital letter, like A or D1.
counters.prefixTaken: Another counter already uses this prefix.
counters.limitExplained: Your plan allows a limited number of counters per venue. Archive a counter or upgrade to add more.
counters.prefixesHint: When prefixes are on, ticket numbers show the counter prefix.
counters.none: No counters yet. Without counters, all orders share one list.
counters.archiveBody: The counter disappears from the staff board and displays. Its prefix becomes free. Past tickets stay in reports.

ratings.intro: What customers said after collecting their order. Deleting a comment keeps the stars in your reports.
ratings.deleteBody: The comment is removed for good. The star rating stays in your reports.

support.codeHint: If you are on the phone with our support team, generate a code and read it to the agent to give them access.
support.codeIntro: Read this code to the support agent:
support.sessionsHint: Our support team can only open your account after you approve. You can end a session at any time.
support.endBody: {{name}} loses access to this account immediately.

staffMembers.title: Named staff
staffMembers.hint: Give each person a personal PIN. When named staff is on, the board asks for it before actions so the activity shows who did what.
staffMembers.name: Name
staffMembers.pinTaken: Another staff member already uses this PIN.
staffMembers.deactivateBody: Their PIN stops working at once. Their past actions stay in the activity log.

integrations.intro: Connect your point of sale or other systems to create tickets automatically and receive status updates.
integrations.viewOnly: You can view integrations. Only the owner can change them.
integrations.showOnce: Copy this now. For your security it will not be shown again.
integrations.keysHint: A key lets another system create and update tickets for this venue only.
integrations.revokeBody: Systems using this key stop working immediately.
integrations.webhooksHint: We send a signed HTTPS request to your URL when a ticket changes.
integrations.urlHint: Must start with https:// and be reachable from the internet.
integrations.rotateBody: A new secret is created and shown once. The old one keeps working for 24 hours so you can update your system.
integrations.deleteBody: No more events are sent to this URL and its delivery log is removed.
integrations.posHint: Connected POS systems create tickets when an order is paid.
integrations.foodicsHint: Create tickets automatically from Foodics orders.
integrations.foodicsSoon: The Foodics connection needs approval from Foodics as a partner app. It will open here once approved; contact support to join the pilot.

posResult.connected: The point of sale is connected. New orders will create tickets automatically.
posResult.cancelled: The connection was cancelled before it finished.
posResult.failed: The point of sale did not accept the connection. Try again, or contact support.
posResult.taken: This point-of-sale location is already connected to another account.
posResult.forbidden: Only the owner can connect a point of sale.
posResult.unavailable: This point of sale is not available on the platform at the moment.

integrations.posDisconnectBody: Orders from this point of sale will stop creating tickets. Tickets already created are kept.
integrations.posNoProviders: No point-of-sale connection is available on this platform yet. Contact support to join the pilot.
integrations.posConnectHint: You will sign in to the point of sale and approve access, then come back here.

trends.title: Compared with the previous period
trends.seriesLabel: Bar chart of tickets per day. The same numbers are in the table below.
trends.cancelReasonsHint: {{n}} cancelled in this period, compared with the previous period.

heatmap.title: Busy hours
heatmap.hint: Tickets created by day of the week and hour (venue local time). Darker means busier.
heatmap.tableHint: Hours without any tickets are left out.
